dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: Why did you follow me..?

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Because we're similar. Both isolated. Both scared

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: I.. ehh

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: It's ok. You don't need to tell me everything here, but I am here for you.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Wait.. Are you crying?

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: No.. Yes, it's just I am not good at this stuff

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: It's weak to show emotion and feelings. I am supposed to be...

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: A strong man

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: I used to be similar. Scared of showing emotion... and being

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: myself

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: I can't force you to do anything, but I can tell you my experience

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Allowing myself to me. I was still scared, but I saw hope

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: I became happier, because I was allowed to express myself inside and out. I laugh and cry being me

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: My connections with my friends became stronger since I allowed myself to open up

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: Aren't you afraid what people will think, what they would do?

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Of course, but worrying. Stopping myself from living is a harsher punishment for being myself.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: There is a quote I heard, not religious, but I stuck with me.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: It’s your road…and yours alone… Others may walk it with you, but no one can walk it for you. No matter what path you choose, really walk it.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: I can't walk your path, and no one can force you, but I can tell you. Being yourself will make you happy.

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: I  don't feel confident telling you everything, but I will walk down my path

dialogue.speaker: Maxwell
dialogue.text: I.. eh uh Thank you
